baselines.definition: Codex tool calls whose board invocations are all read/wait, none piped to python/jq, none a --help/-h invocation, with a recorded result, AND call_class == single_board_read (chatboard_board_use.call_class): exactly one tool invocation in the call, whose one shell command (shlex-tokenised; no ; && || | & < > ( ) token, no unquoted newline, so no heredoc, chain, cmds=[...] array or loop) is the board read, with the script only passing the result to text() unmodified (no JSON.parse/.map/.slice/... : that makes it a projection, class post_processed). Reported: median output_chars and count with a truncation marker (markers in chatboard_board_use.py). Calls the parser cannot decide (cmd not a plain literal, unrecognised wrapper, non-exec_command tool) are class unclassified:<reason>, excluded from the primary figure and counted in `unclassified_in_single_tool_call`. Variants: single_tool_call = exactly one tool invocation (call_tools == 1, the previous primary; its shell command may still chain others, 50 of its calls do and 2 post-process); all_batched_calls = any number of tool invocations per call, help calls included (result text may belong to co-batched commands, so it does NOT measure board reads); single_board_invocation = all_batched_calls restricted to one board invocation, help excluded. Whether the draft used the primary definition is not established.
baselines.label: recomputed
